Assigning courses to a batch ensures that all users in that batch have access to the assigned courses, simplifying the process of granting course access to multiple users simultaneously.

No Content Assigned

Assigning content to this batch to grant all users access to course contents. This approach simplifies content access management, allowing multiple users to view content simultaneously.
